Merging and data scaling

Combined_hpa <- merge(obj_0_hpa_B_processed, y = c(obj_1_hpa_B_processed, obj_3_hpa_A_processed, obj_12_hpa_A_processed), project = "Combined_hpa")
## Warning: Some cell names are duplicated across objects provided. Renaming to
## enforce unique cell names.
all.genes <- rownames(Combined_hpa)
Combined_hpa <- NormalizeData(Combined_hpa)
## Normalizing layer: counts.ravi_0_hpa_B
## Normalizing layer: counts.ravi_1_hpa_B
## Normalizing layer: counts.ravi_3_hpa_A
## Normalizing layer: counts.ravi_12_hpa_A
Combined_hpa <- FindVariableFeatures(Combined_hpa)
## Finding variable features for layer counts.ravi_0_hpa_B
## Finding variable features for layer counts.ravi_1_hpa_B
## Finding variable features for layer counts.ravi_3_hpa_A
## Finding variable features for layer counts.ravi_12_hpa_A
Combined_hpa <- ScaleData(Combined_hpa, features = all.genes)
## Centering and scaling data matrix
